name: Bloody Retribution
description: Unique Active - Retribution''s damage against creeps and minions is increased to 150%. When cast on an enemy hero, deals them 100 True Damage and steals HP equal to 250 plus 20% of the caster''s extra HP from them for 4 seconds. Retribution is upgraded when the total number of creep kills, hero kills, and assists reaches 5

name: Revitalize
description:
Summons a Healing Spring that restores 2.5% Max HP every 0.5 second for 5 seconds (maximum of 25% Max HP).
Increases the Shield and HP Regen by 25% for allies within the area of effect (this effect is cannot be stacked up).

name: Sprint
description: Gains up to 50% extra Movement Speed and slow immunity for 6s. The extra Movement Speed gradually decays after 2s.

name: Ice Retribution
description: Unique Active - Retribution's damage against creeps and minions is increased to 150%. When cast on an enemy hero, deals them 100 True Damage and steals 72-100 Movement Speed (scales with level) from them for 4 seconds. Retribution is upgraded when the total number of creep kills, hero kills, and assists reaches 5.

name: Flame Retribution
description: Unique Active - Retribution's damage against creeps and minions is increased to 150%. When cast on an enemy hero, deals them 100 True Damage and steals 58-100 Physical Attack and Magic Power (scales with level) from them for 4 seconds. Retribution is upgraded when the total number of creep kills, hero kills, and assists reaches 5.

name: Vengeance
description:
In the next 3 seconds, each time the hero takes damage deals 40% of the damage taken as Magic Damage to the enemy.
Gains 35% Damage Reduction during the period.

name: Arrival
description: After channeling for 3s, teleport to the target allied Turret, Base, Minion, or trap and gain 60% extra Movement Speed (decays over 3s) afterward. if the channeling is canceled or interupted, 30s of the spelll cooldown will be refunded

name: Execute
description:
Deals 100 (+10 × Hero Level) (+enemy's 13% Lost HP) True Damage to the designated enemy hero.
This damage ignores shield. If the target is slain by this skill, its cooldown will be reduced by 40%.

name: Flameshot
description:
Fires a Flaming Shot in a designated direction, dealing 160 (+60% Total Magic Power)–640 +180% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage (scales on distance) and slowing the target by 30% for 0.5 second.
Casting the skill knocks back nearby enemies.

name: Flicker
description: Moves a certain distance in a designated direction. Then gains 6 (+1 × Hero Level) Physical and Magic Defense for 1 second.

name: Inspire
description:
For up to 6  Basic Attacks within the next 5 seconds, increase Attack Speed to 1.5 times and the Attack Speed cap to 500%.
The Basic Attacks also ignore 8(+1*Hero Level) of target's Hybrid Defense and restore 60 (+15% Total Physical Attack) (+10% Total Magic Power) HP on hit.

name: Petrify
description: Deals 100 (+15 × Hero Level) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and petrifies them for 0.8s. Enemies hit will also be slowed by 50% for 0.8s afterward.

name: Purify
description:
Immediately removes all negative effects.
In the next 1.2 seconds, gains control immunity and 15% Movement Speed.
